name: Ace 3
description-body:
Set Up Ace 3

When you set up Ace 3, be sure you are using the phone or tablet you would like it to connect to.

After tapping “Continue,” you will:

1. Make a Fitbit account if you haven't already done so.

2. Create a family account if you don't have one.

3. Add a new child or select an existing one.

4. Switch to kid view to complete setup for your child's Ace 3.

adult-gaia.description-body:
On this phone
Go to your Family, switch to your child’s profile, and add an Ace 3 device

On your child’s phone
Sign in to Fitbit with your child’s Google Account, and add an Ace 3 device

child-gaia.description-body: Give your device to the parent who is a Google family manager. They can help you do the next step.
